entry.summary: potential revenue split among school, town, Monty Tech. A hypothetical distribution of the new FY27 revenue based on each entity's share of the budget was presented, with school at 53.3%, town at 43.91%, and Monty Tech at 2.76%.

entry.title: The Monty Tech assessment: Finance Committee, 2026-01-27
entry.summary: Monty Tech assessment increase. Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School assessment was noted to have increased 8.8%, substantially exceeding its proportional share.

entry.summary: Net new revenue after health insurance and apportionment among school, town and Monty Tech

entry.summary: Revenue apportionment. School approximately $696,521 above FY26; town approximately $573,000; Monty Tech approximately $36,000

entry.title: The Monty Tech assessment: Finance Committee, 2026-01-08
entry.summary: Bring Monty Tech in earlier in the budget calendar, before their board votes on its assessment, rather than after.
